polyinstantiation_enabled.description: Enable polyinstantiation of directory namespaces (e.g., /tmp, /var/tmp, user homes) to provide isolated per-user views.

polyinstance_dir.description: Base directory used for creating polyinstantiated temporary directories when no per-directory template is specified.

home_template.description: Template path for polyinstantiated home directories (e.g., '/home/polyinst.%u' where %u is replaced by username).

poly_dirs.description: List of directories to polyinstantiate, each with its access mode and template.

path.description: Absolute path of the directory to polyinstantiate (e.g., '/tmp', '/var/tmp', '/home/user').

mode.description: Directory mode (in octal) for the polyinstantiated instances (e.g., '0755', '0700').

template.description: Template path for the polyinstantiated instance. May contain placeholders like %u (username), %p (parent path), %U (uid). If empty, use global polyinstance_dir/home_template.
